content.overview: Subject to the articles, every Member initially receives only such value for produce or products pooled and supplied as the Board determines; withheld price may later be disbursed in cash, kind or equity shares in proportion to produce supplied. Members receive only a limited return on share capital (bonus shares may be allotted under s. 378ZJ). Surplus after limited return and reserves may be disbursed as patronage bonus in proportion to participation, in cash or equity shares or both, as decided by Members at the general meeting.
content.glance: Withheld price, limited return on capital, and patronage bonus are the three statutory forms of Member benefit.
content.study: Section 378E structures the economic benefits available to Members of a Producer Company. The Board sets the initial value for pooled produce and may later disburse the withheld price. Return on share capital is limited, subject to possible bonus-share allotment under s. 378ZJ. Any remaining surplus after limited return and the reserves required by s. 378ZI may be distributed as patronage bonus according to participation in the business.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: Members receive (1) value for produce (with possible withheld-price disbursement), (2) limited return on capital, and (3) patronage bonus from surplus, as governed by the articles and the section.

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378E
examples.body: A Member who supplies a larger quantity of primary produce receives a correspondingly larger share of any patronage bonus declared under s. 378E(3).

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378E?
hypotheticals.analysis: It fixes the three forms of Member benefit — produce payment, limited capital return, and patronage bonus — and links them to Board and general-meeting decisions.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming Members are entitled to unlimited dividends on share capital.
misconceptions.correction: Return on share capital is limited; surplus is distributed as patronage bonus according to participation.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378E be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the three benefit streams. II. Apply Board/general-meeting decisions and proportionality rules. III. Conclude.
